dating: index 0 = the end of 2026-09 (2026Q3), the state measured on data to September 2026; index k = the end of the k-th month after (index 1 = 2026-10, the first simulated month); index 72 = 2032-09. A reading named by a quarter is its months' average (gc.to_quarters): quarter 1 = 2026Q4, the first simulated quarter; quarter 9 = 2028Q4; quarter 24 = 2032Q3 (decisions 43 and 91)

bust.path: the 2000-02 bust, measured (global_crash.bust_2000), dated from the peak

levers.note: the month each region's fiscal lever starts: the month after its unemployment first reads two points above its start in the case's low end and in its high end (gc.trigger_dates), the case's the midpoint to the month; the same dates in every piece, sensitivity and alternative

piece_by_piece.note: each row takes one piece of the case (at its high end) back to the model's central setting, the levers on the case's dates; 'adds' is the case minus that run, the difference of the unrounded runs' quarterly averages rounded once: at 2028Q4, at 2032Q2, and at the peak (2032Q3 while still rising)

sensitivities.note: each changes one setting the case does not carry, on the case at its high end, the levers on the case's dates; at the peak and at 2032Q2

alternatives.note: each changes the bust (or switches decision 27's energy term on, or puts the levers on either end's dates), on the case at its high end; paths for the watcher's vocabulary, not scored
